line: Our life is a dewdrop on the grass. The sun is already rising.
No day gets a second morning. Use this one: the years won't wait.
Looking back, no one regretted learning a skill. The biggest regrets: things never done.
credit: Gilovich & Medvec · J Pers Soc Psychol, 1994

line: Hard to get up? Remember: you rise to do a human being's work.
credit: Marcus Aurelius · Meditations V.1, tr. Long

line: Then treat this morning's practice as a meeting that comes once in a lifetime.
Mornings start the night before. Basketball players who slept more ran faster, shot better.
credit: C. D. Mah et al. · Sleep, 2011

line: Add the basics: moderate exercise, and just enough food to refuel, not overload.
credit: Cicero · On Old Age, tr. Falconer

line: At 107, she had just released her sixth piano album. 'Youth is inside us.'
While your body is well, put your biggest effort into what matters most.
For 80 years, Casals began each day playing Bach. Begin yours: practise today.
